item.tib: 'jig rten snod bcud kyi 'grel ba gsal ba'i sgron me snang srid gsal bar byed pa'i lde mig
item.coloph: de ltar 'jig rten snod kyi gnas lugs sil bur bstan pa'i 'grel pa/ snang srid gsal bar byed pa'i lde mig ces bya ba/thog med blo gros kyi spyan dang ldan cing / lnga brgya'i dus 'dir/ mnyam med gzhan gyi 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba'i/ bru ston 'dul ba rgyal mtshan gyis zhabs rdul spyi bos len cing / 'phrul ngag bden pa'i bon la shes rab rnam gsum tshul bzhin sbyangs pa'i bru yi btsun pa rgyal ba g.yung drung la/ blo gsal dad pa ldan pa'i tre ston dad pa rgyal mtshan dang / shes che brtson 'grus mnga' ba'i/ nam mkha' g.yung drung gis bskul te/ gdan sa chen po g.yas ru dben sa khar bkrol zhing sbyar ba rdzogs so//
